attrInput.name: input
attrInput.comment: The ocean's short waves as a tangent-space normal, 0 to 1 (the kit's split tile, read by an ImageMap).

attrDial.name: dial
attrDial.comment: How far the short waves tilt the normal: 0 not at all, 1 as the tile has them.

attrHorizon.name: horizon
attrHorizon.comment: The lowest a mirror reflection off the water may point, as the sine of its angle above the world's horizon. A reflection the short waves would send below it, where a real sea has another wave in the way, is bent up to it.
